doc.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024

title: Goodbyes and Kenny Davern memories
summary: The two recall a Hamilton College gig with Kenny Davern, Tony DeNicola and James Chirillo, and say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. Thanks a lot, John. It’s a pleasure hooking up with you again and I hope to see you in person at some point.
You know I think I have a DVD of us in Hamilton College, you sat in on clarinet?
Soprano, yeah. I never had a player so I never saw it.
I remember the gig you know. Tony DeNicola, James Chirillo.
And Kenny. Kenny was one of a kind.
I’ll say. I miss him. We miss him. A lot of people miss Kenny. Yeah. All right man.
All right. Thank you very much.
